channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Sources: Clippers trade James Harden to Cavaliers for Darius Garland
item.description: The deal gives the 36-year-old Harden, an 11-time All-Star, a chance to join a contender, while the Clippers get younger with Garland, 26, and acquire a second-round draft pick.

item.title: Orange County scores and player stats for Tuesday, Feb. 3
item.description: Scores and stats from Orange County games on Tuesday, Feb. 3

item.title: Lakers rout Nets as Austin Reaves returns in finale of 8-game trip
item.description: LeBron James scores 25 points, Luka Doncic has 24 and the Lakers roll to a 125-109 win to close a 5-3 trip in Reaves’ first game since Christmas. Reaves scores 15 points in 21 minutes after missing the past 19 games with a strained left calf.

item.title: UCLA men bounce back by dismantling Rutgers
item.description: Xavier Booker, Donovan Dent and Tyler Bilodeau set the pace as the Bruins take out the frustration of their double-overtime loss to Indiana with a 98-66 rout of the struggling Scarlet Knights.

item.title: Democratic candidates for governor embrace the high-speed rail boondoggle
item.description: That bodes poorly for anyone hoping for some evidence that California Democrats are capable of recognizing failure when they see it.

item.title: Alijah Arenas’ breakout game helps USC finish off Indiana
item.description: The highly touted freshman scores a team-high 29 points as the Trojans hold off the Hoosiers, 81-75, on a night when Chad Baker-Mazara leaves with an injury early in the second half and two other starters foul out late.

item.title: Esperanza girls basketball edges Villa Park for undefeated league title
item.description: Charlotte Muller scores the winning basket with 6.2 seconds left off an inbound pass as Esperanza goes undefeated in the Crestview League.

item.title: Ducks top Kraken, roll into Olympic break on a tear
item.description: Cutter Gauthier, Jacob Trouba, Alex Killorn and Ross Johnston score, and Milan-bound Lukáš Dostál stops 26 shots as the Ducks win for the ninth time in 11 games, 4-2.

item.title: Governor’s race: Sparks fly as San Jose mayor fends off rivals from left and right in first debate
item.description: The televised debate saw few attacks in a race that recently got more crowded.

item.title: Esperanza boys basketball earns outright league title by defeating Troy
item.description: Esperanza had lost to Troy in mid-January, but their adjustments on defense pay off in the North Hills League finale.
